parameters.name: AgentGroup
parameters.description:
The type of detection points used by the task. Valid values:

- PC: PC-based detection points.

- MOBILE: mobile-based detection points.

- FC: internal detection points.

parameters.name: Keyword
parameters.description:
The keyword used to search for site monitoring tasks.

> Fuzzy match is supported based on the task name or task address.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the site monitoring task.

parameters.name: TaskState
parameters.description:
The task status. Valid values:

- 1: Normal.

- 2: Disabled.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description: The type of the site monitoring task. CloudMonitor supports the following types: HTTP, PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, and FTP.
